name: hat_crown
where: Top of head, roughly y 0.93 to 1.01 (tick labels), x about -0.05 to +0.05 around the head centreline; tall flat-topped felt crown with rounded top edge.
shape: Straight-sided fedora crown with a flat, slightly rounded top and a soft rounded rim where it meets the band.
seen_in: out/survey_head_tex.png front, fl, left, bl, back panels
notes: Sits on the head. Crown is the base for the band, dents and studs. Reference crown is a plain cylinder with no dents.

name: hat_crown_dent
where: Upper crown, about y 0.97 to 1.00. Two eye-shaped dents on the front of the crown (centre-left and centre-right of the crown front), and one dent on each side of the crown (left and right panels).
shape: Smooth, eye-like or rounded indentations pressed into the felt, with soft raised edges.
seen_in: out/survey_head_clay.png front and left, right panels
in_reference: differs: reference crown reads as smooth with no sculpted dents at this scale
notes: Sculpted dents, not paint: clay shows them as shaded hollows. The front pair is symmetric. Modeller should decide whether to keep them as geometry or drop them. Count 4 is a best read; a fifth dent may sit at the back.

name: hat_crown_stud
where: Upper right of the crown, about y 0.98 to 1.00, near the right-hand rim, seen in the right panel as two small round bumps.
shape: Two small round bumps standing proud of the crown surface.
notes: Tiny bumps; could be rivets or sculpt noise. Only visible from the right side view.

name: hat_brim
where: Wide brim around the crown base, about y 0.90 to 0.95, extending outward roughly 0.2 to 0.25 units from each side of the crown; the front and sides droop slightly and the back is flatter.
shape: Wide, flat, slightly drooping fedora brim with a rounded thick edge all round.
seen_in: out/survey_head_tex.png front, fl, left and right panels
notes: Sits over the band. The underside of the brim has a dark interior ring and the inner head opening, which reads as the hat's interior (see hat_inner_ring).

name: hat_brim_stud
where: Front edge of the brim, about y 0.91, just left of the centreline in the front panel and near the front-bottom in the top panel.
shape: Single small round bump on the brim edge.
notes: Possibly a stud or a sculpt bump. Low confidence.

name: hat_inner_ring
where: Underside of the brim, around the head opening, about y 0.88 to 0.92; visible in the bottom panel as a dark ring around the head.
shape: Dark ring-shaped lining or sweatband on the underside of the brim around the head opening.
notes: Could be a separate sweatband or simply the crown's inner wall. Only seen from below.

name: hat_band
where: Ring around the base of the crown, about y 0.94 to 0.96, running all the way round the crown.
shape: Dark band, slightly raised above the crown, with gold edge trim along top and bottom.
notes: Gold trim lines run along both edges. Sits between crown and brim, so the brim is over its lower edge. Top-view shows a small rectangular tab at the front of the band ring (see hat_emblem).

name: hat_band_gold_edge
where: Top and bottom edges of the band, all the way round, about y 0.95 and 0.94.
shape: Two thin gold strips running round the band, one on each edge.
notes: Painted gold in tex; clay shows them as slight raised lines. Could be painted only.

name: hat_band_stud
where: Evenly spaced round studs around the band, about y 0.95. Front panel has a pair either side of the emblem, plus 2 more at the outer front-left and front-right edges. Back panel has 3 round studs in the centre plus 2 at the outer edges.
shape: Small round domed studs.
seen_in: out/survey_head_tex.png front, fl, left, back panels
notes: Count 12 is a best read, not exact. Left and right counts are roughly equal. The back-centre stud group is evenly spaced. Recount on the top view before modelling.

name: hat_band_hook
where: Rear of the band, one on the left-rear and one on the right-rear, about y 0.94 to 0.96. Left-side hook is near the left panel's rear edge; right-side one is at the right panel's rear edge.
shape: Small hook or loop-shaped clasp sticking out from the band.
notes: Look like strap-end clasps or keepers. Left/right placement from side panels. Exact sides are not confirmed.

name: hat_emblem
where: Front of the band, centre, about y 0.93 to 0.97, x near 0, standing proud of the band.
shape: Diamond or lozenge-shaped gold emblem with a cross or crossbow-like inner form, raised off the band with a flat base plate.
notes: The top view shows a small rectangular base tab at the front of the band ring under the emblem. Treat the tab as the emblem's base plate, not a separate piece, unless it is clearly separate on the modelling pass.

name: mask
where: Face, from under the brim (about y 0.91) down to the chin tip (about y 0.85 to 0.86), x centred on the head, roughly 0.1 wide.
shape: Tall, pointed visor-style face plate with a flat front and angled sides, narrowing to a chin point, glowing orange.
seen_in: out/survey_head_tex.png front, fl, left, right and fr panels
notes: Orange in colour (the glow is paint, the plate is geometry). The clay shows a bevelled edge around the mask outline. Mask sits over the head and under the brim.

name: mask_slit_line
where: Front of the mask, two vertical lines running from just under the brim to about y 0.88, spaced either side of the centreline.
shape: Two vertical bright lines, each a narrow engraved groove or slit with a raised edge.
notes: Clay shows them as grooves, so they may be geometry (slits or engraved lines) and not only paint. Yellow glow in tex is paint. Confirm on the modelling pass.

name: mask_edge_trim
where: Outline of the mask, all round its edge, from under the brim to the chin point.
shape: Thin raised rim or bevel framing the mask face.
notes: Only a bevelled edge in clay, not clearly a separate piece. Could just be the mask's edge.

name: head_hood
where: Head and neck area under the brim and behind the mask, roughly y 0.80 to 0.93, x centred on the head.
shape: Dark, near-black covered head or hood shape that the mask sits on and the ears attach to.
notes: Under-layer, near-black. No hair is visible under the hat in any panel, so no hair object is listed. Hood surface meets the neck wrap at the bottom.

name: ear_left
where: Side of the head on the character's left (larger x), about y 0.91 to 0.94, just under the brim and behind the mask.
shape: Sculpted ear with a clear helix ridge and a dark hollow.
in_reference: differs: ear is hidden under the hat in the reference views
notes: Sculpted geometry, not paint. Shape reads as a full ear.

name: ear_right
where: Side of the head on the character's right (smaller x), about y 0.91 to 0.94, just under the brim.
shape: Sculpted ear with a helix ridge and a dark hollow.
in_reference: differs: ear is hidden under the hat in the reference views
notes: Mirror of ear_left in form, shape looks slightly different in the back panel.

name: neck_wrap
where: Neck, from under the mask chin (about y 0.85) down to about y 0.82, wrapping the throat and meeting the coat collar.
shape: Dark cloth wrap with a V-shaped front and soft folds, layered over the neck.
notes: Layered: sits under the stand-up collar at the back and sides, and against the chin of the mask at the front.

name: coat_stand_collar
where: Around the neck and up to the back of the head, about y 0.86 to 0.92 at the back; front wings at about y 0.85 to 0.88 beside the mask.
shape: Tall stand-up coat collar, rising at the back and flaring at the sides with a folded top edge.
seen_in: out/survey_head_tex.png back, bl, left and br panels
notes: Sits over neck_wrap at the back and sides. Front lapel wings belong to the coat body, not this object; they are outside this region. Collar is dark blue cloth, not near-black.

name: coat_collar_trim
where: Outer edge of the stand-up collar at the sides and front, about y 0.85 to 0.92.
shape: Thin gold edging running along the collar edge.
notes: Gold in tex; clay shows only a faint edge line. Likely painted or a thin strip.
